embedded_ivos.text: Seemingly overnight, and without public consent, major technology companies have embedded artificial intelligence (AI) into the bedrock of daily life. [...] As long as tech billionaires are permitted to amass unchecked profits from this new technology, AI’s influence will only expand — regardless of the harms it inflicts on working people and the planet. We cannot stand by while a handful of CEOs reshape our entire economy to further concentrate wealth and power. As your representative in Congress, Claire will fight to hold major technology corporations accountable, protect our workforce from the harms of AI, and ensure that new technologies benefit communities, not just corporate executives.

deepseek.reason: The statement criticizes corporate AI power but does not mention embedded independent auditors or internal access.
deepseek.confidence_reason: There is no reference to independent verification organizations or embedded oversight.
